sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Service Tribunals Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2010
ACT IV OF 2010
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE SERVICE
TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the
North-West
Frontier Province
Service Tribunals Act, 1974
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary,
26th February, 2010]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Bills/2010/7787,
dated 26-2-2010.---The North-West Frontier Province
Service Tribunals (Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on 20th February, 2010 and assented to
by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province on 24th February, 2010, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier Province.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the
North-West Frontier Province Service Tribunals Act, 1974 (N.-W.F.P. Act No.I of 1974), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
(2) It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Service Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.
Amendment
of section 7 of N.-W.F.P. Act No. I of 1974.---In the North-West
Frontier Province Service Tribunals Act, 1974 (N.-W.F.P. Act No. I
of 1974), in section 7, in subsection (2), in clause (c), the full-stop
appearing at the end shall be replaced by a semi-colon and the word
"and", and thereafter the following new clause shall be added,
namely:
"(d) execution of its decisions.",
